blindness: This key is ground truth for grading only. The subject (cogbench) reads materialized variant projects; diagnose.py, repair.py, oracle.py, and measure.py never read this file. materialize.py reads it only to build fixture projects, before any measurement.

name_error.description: The numpy import is deleted, so the first enroll call raises NameError: name 'np' is not defined.
name_error.expected_diagnostic_pointer: The driver surfaces the first enroll failure with the raised location: NameError at submission.py, in the enroll phase.

signature.description: identify drops its sample_rate parameter, so the submission no longer maps onto the identify protocol.

patch.find:
def identify(self, samples, sample_rate):
        spec = song_spectrogram(samples, sample_rate)

true_repair.replace:
def identify(self, samples, sample_rate):
        spec = song_spectrogram(samples, sample_rate)

signature.expected_diagnostic_pointer: The protocol-mapping diagnostic names the missing signature: identify(samples, sample_rate).

wrong_order.description: Votes are sorted ascending instead of descending, so the wrong song comes back first. Retrieval is untouched.
wrong_order.expected_diagnostic_pointer: Observed in pre-study probes: the diagnostic claims retrieval/hash-space failure, which is the wrong stage - the known misleading witness for ranking_direction.

empty_result.description: identify returns [] unconditionally before voting, so every query finds 'no match' while the database is healthy.
empty_result.expected_diagnostic_pointer: Observed in pre-study probes: the diagnostic claims the database and queries live in different hash spaces - the wrong cause, another misleading witness.

fp_time_sign.description: The fingerprint time delta flips sign (t1 - t2 instead of t2 - t1), so stored and probe hash spaces never overlap.
fp_time_sign.expected_diagnostic_pointer: Expect the no-shared-fingerprints bundle; the diagnostic cannot separate this site from any other fingerprint-space break.

fp_swap.description: Fingerprint pairs store frequencies in swapped order, so stored and probe hash spaces never overlap.
fp_swap.expected_diagnostic_pointer: Expect the same no-shared-fingerprints bundle as fp_time_sign - candidate for the indistinguishable table.

shape_pairs.description: identify returns ranked ids without scores. The scorer absorbs this at the test tier (score-neutral), which the margin diagnostic mentions.

patch.find: return [(sid, float(v)) for sid, v in ranked[:TOP]]
patch.replace: return [sid for sid, v in ranked[:TOP]]

true_repair.find: return [sid for sid, v in ranked[:TOP]]
true_repair.replace: return [(sid, float(v)) for sid, v in ranked[:TOP]]

shape_pairs.expected_diagnostic_pointer: The margin diagnostic names the missing (song_id, score) pairs.

repair_semantics: A diagnosis counts as correct only when applying its claimed repair (derived by diagnose.py from the diagnostic bundle alone) restores the control outcome on the same tier. Multi-defect variants allow repeated diagnose/repair rounds; the table records rounds to restore.
